title: WumboLabs eval profile descriptor
description: Profile identity descriptor (profile.json) for a WumboLabs canonical public evaluation repository. Establishes WHICH tested deployment/scientific surface the repository is canonical for; it never duplicates scientific reports. Contract: one profile_id maps to exactly one canonical public eval repository; one profile may contain many events of the same material tested surface. Added 2026-09-12 by the model/profile/event publication-identity milestone.

model_id.description: Stable model identity; maps to exactly one canonical Labs page (e.g. qwen38-27b).

profile_id.description: Materially distinct tested deployment/scientific surface this repository is canonical for. Must match the model_id prefix convention and the repository identity.

runtime_family.description: Runtime engine family (e.g. llama.cpp, ExLlamaV3, vLLM).

runtime_version.description: Pinned runtime version/commit identity where established.

artifact.description: Tested model artifact identity (file/quant family, source revision where established).

artifact_precision.description: Weight/KV precision of the tested artifact.

deployment_topology.description: Material serving topology of the profile (residency, speculation/MTP surface, history mode, batch/width), where applicable.

hardware_scope.description: Hardware scope of the evidence (e.g. WumboJetsII, RTX 5070 12GB).

repository.description: The canonical public eval repository this descriptor lives in (owner/name).

first_event.description: event_id of the first published event on this profile.

current_status.description: Role of this profile among the model's tested profiles. CURRENT = canonical/recommended tested surface; CURRENT_ALTERNATE = validated alternate; HISTORICAL = earlier tested surface retained as evidence; SUPERSEDED = replaced by a materially different accepted profile; SPECIALIZED = niche tested surface.

notes.description: Optional bounded clarification (e.g. provenance of a split repository).
